searchText: From this perspective I would probably discuss deprecation of mplex in favor of yamux. My point is that yamux is a way more complex than mplex, provides not that many benefits (if any at all in our use case). Assuming this I would prefer to keep fallback protocol simple and battle tested, i.e. TCP + Noise + Mplex nodes MUST support both QUIC and TCP till all clients have QUIC support, right?
